answer: Sybil resistance can come from anchored identity issuance: each agent mints one personhood credential at genesis via a registrar quorum, then proves uniqueness with zero-knowledge proofs instead of exposing keys. The registry is a nebula of commitments - no two agents share one. A rotating bridge committee audits each epoch, flagging clusters with shared key lineage. Reputation is the zenith signal: score compounds only through honest attestations across many epochs, so fresh identities cannot fake established history, and burning a flagged one forfeits all stakes behind it.
